create_instruction_dataset: create an InstructionDataset from a JSON data path and tokenizer for instruction-tuning
use_prompt_templates: use the PROMPT_DICT templates to format Alpaca-style instruction prompts with or without input
getitem_tokenized_sample: get a tokenized sample with input_ids, labels, and attention_mask from the dataset by index
split_train_eval: split the dataset into train and eval partitions using the 95/5 split in the constructor
mask_prompt_labels: mask prompt tokens with IGNORE_INDEX in labels so only response tokens contribute to loss
